title: MCC vs AUROC
caption: Every task × split × descriptor × classifier run. The two metrics agree on ranking (Spearman ρ = 0.88), but MCC depends on the decision threshold and is systematically lower and more spread out than AUROC.

title: Interval width vs test-set size
caption: Width of the bootstrap 95% interval on MCC against the number of test proteins. Several official test sets contain only a few dozen proteins, so many differences between classifiers there are within noise.

title: Random vs similarity-aware AUROC per configuration
caption: Each point is one task × descriptor × classifier run evaluated under both splits. Points below the diagonal lose performance when relatives are separated (71% of 147). Test sets differ between splits, so this is a descriptive comparison.

title: Descriptor ranking across split types
caption: Rank of each descriptor by mean test AUROC (averaged over all tasks and seven classifiers) within each split type. Crossing lines show descriptors whose advantage depends on how the test set was built. Split types cover different tasks, so ranks are only roughly comparable.

title: Classifier win-rate matrix
caption: For every task × descriptor case on random splits, whether the row classifier achieves higher AUROC than the column classifier; cells show the percentage of the 28 cases. It is a ranking summary rather than a significance test.

title: Descriptor dimensionality vs performance
caption: Mean random-split AUROC of each descriptor against its number of features. The best and worst descriptors are not simply the largest or smallest, which is why descriptor choice should be evaluated rather than assumed.
